items.title: Rico Dowdle: Questionable for Week 7
items.text:
Dowdle (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Seemingly avoids serious setback
items.text:
The calf injury Nacua sustained Thursday is believed to be "more minor than anything else" and "not significant," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Minimal role in Week 7 loss
items.text:
Henderson rushed three times for nine yards and secured both targets for 14 yards in the Patriots' 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday.

items.title: Hunter Henry: Busy night in Week 7 loss
items.text:

items.title: Rome Odunze: Outproduced by Burden again
items.text:
Odunze brought in four of five targets for 69 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.
